subject: Specialized reservation discovery — recap, isolation needs, and next steps
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sam Reid <sam.reid@medanalytics.com>; Priya Nair <priya.nair@medanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Specialized reservation discovery — recap, isolation needs, and next steps

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick write-up to capture what we heard on the call and the proposed next steps so everyone is aligned. I kept this intentionally short and action-oriented.

Summary of pain points
- Peak inference windows (ML infra) are spiky: 80–90% of requests concentrate in 2 two-hour windows/day, causing tail latency > 600ms.
- Regulatory requirement to logically isolate PHI models and logs; MedAnalytics needs tenant isolation with distinct VM/TENANT boundaries.
- Current on-prem cluster struggles with burst capacity for overnight batch scoring.

Goals you stated
1) Reliable sub-200ms p95 for online scoring during peak windows.
2) Logical isolation (no cross-tenant memory/kv-cache sharing) and audit logs retained for 13 months.
3) Predictable monthly cost model for reserved GPU capacity with defined burst behavior.

What Redwood would propose (high level)
- Dedicated reserved pool: 6x A100-equivalent GPUs initially (can be mixed config) with a 2x burst buffer for scheduled nightly batches.
- Isolation: tenant-dedicated processes + KV cache partitioning; optional private VPC endpoint for all control-plane interactions.
- SLOs: 99.9% uptime SLA, target p95 latency <= 200ms for production route (can pin to smaller model variant if needed).

Open items / clarifying questions
- Can you confirm the expected sustained RPS during the two spike windows (Sam) — we used ~400 RPS in our sizing exercise but want confirmation.
- Are there any existing KMS/HSM policies we need to factor into the onboarding (Priya)?
- Do you need on-prem deployment (air-gapped) or will VPC-hosted Dedicated satisfy compliance?

Immediate next steps (owners & timing)
- Sam: Share RPS distribution by hour + any SLAs with your customers (due EOD Tue, Nov 30).
- Priya: Confirm KMS/HSM constraints and whether 13 months retention is acceptable for audit logs (due Mon, Nov 30).
- Vivek: Send capacity estimate + preliminary network/topology checklist (attached). Will loop in Solutions Engineering to run a quick 60-min design session.

Attachments: capacity_estimate_v1.pdf (high-level cost & GPU mix), network_topology.png

If that aligns with your read, I’ll schedule the design session for the week of Dec 7.

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Sam Reid <sam.reid@medanalytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@medanalytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Specialized reservation discovery — recap, isolation needs, and next steps

Vivek — thanks for the recap, looks good. A few clarifications inline:

- RPS: Confirming the two windows are roughly 350–420 RPS each; sustained baseline outside windows ~45 RPS. Peak bursts can hit ~600 RPS for 5–10 minutes (unexpected spikes).
- Retention: 13 months is OK for us, but logs must be exportable to our SIEM on request.
- Deployment: We prefer VPC-hosted Dedicated to start; we may evaluate on-prem down the road for additional compliance controls.

Next stuff we’ll send:
- RPS export for last 60 days (Priya will attach).
- A short compliance checklist (we’ll highlight KMS/rotation cadence).

Agree on Dec 7 design session — please send a couple of times.

—Sam
Sam Reid
VP Product, MedAnalytics
From: Priya Nair <priya.nair@medanalytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sam Reid <sam.reid@medanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:11:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Specialized reservation discovery — recap, isolation needs, and next steps

Vivek / Sam — attaching the RPS export as requested (RPS_export_60d.csv). A couple of notes from compliance:
- We use AWS KMS with rotation every 90 days; we require CMKs for any customer-data-at-rest encryption.
- Audit logs need to be E2E and signed; 13 months retention is correct.

If Redwood can provide the VPC-hosted option with a dedicated KMS integration pattern and signed audit logs, we should be able to proceed to procurement.

Attachment: RPS_export_60d.csv (attached)

Thanks,
Priya Nair
Head of Security & Compliance
MedAnalytics

Appreciate the quick turn. Action update:
- I’ve shared the capacity_estimate_v1.pdf + network_topology.png to the Drive folder (link above) and also attached copies here.
- SE ask: Karthik — can you run a 45-minute sizing + burst-policy design session? Prefer Wed, Dec 9 at 10:00 or Thu, Dec 10 at 11:00 PT — which works?
- Marissa — once we align on slot sizing we should surface the preliminary commercial terms (commit months / burst policy) so procurement has something to review.

Karthik: quick notes for the session you can prepare — target config rows for 6x reserved + 2x burst, network egress sizing, and KMS integration pattern for AWS CMKs.

Will wait to lock the session once Sam/Priya confirm one of the two windows above.

Thanks everyone —
Vivek
